sourceMaterials.title: Priya Nwosu — academic CV
sourceMaterials.content: Priya Chidinma Nwosu. BSc Molecular Biology, University of Ibadan, 2017–2021; MSc Bioinformatics, African Institute for Mathematical Sciences, 2022–2024. Research associate at the West African Centre for Cell Biology of Infectious Pathogens, August 2024–present. Research uses single-cell RNA sequencing and pathogen genomics. First-author paper ‘Cell-state signatures of severe malaria’ accepted by PLOS Computational Biology on 12 June 2026 and listed as in press; DOI has not yet been assigned. Co-author of two published genomic-surveillance papers. Skills: R, Python, Nextflow, scRNA-seq and Bayesian modelling.

sourceMaterials.title: Consolidated degree records
sourceMaterials.content: BSc Molecular Biology: CGPA 4.41/5.00, requirements completed 9 July 2021, conferred 31 August 2021. MSc Bioinformatics: final average 82/100, requirements completed 18 June 2024, conferred 30 August 2024. Graduate courses include Statistical Genetics, Algorithms for Bioinformatics, Machine Learning, Genomics and Research Methods.

sourceMaterials.title: Research employment
sourceMaterials.content: West African Centre research associate, 12 August 2024–present. MSc research fellowship, 1 September 2023–18 June 2024, overlapping with full-time study and explicitly part of the degree. Ghanaian permanent residence; Nigerian citizenship. Current address: 17 Boundary Road, East Legon, Accra, Ghana. Permanent address: 42 Adebisi Street, Ibadan, Nigeria.

sourceMaterials.title: Academic referee information
sourceMaterials.content: Professor Amina Bello supervised Priya’s MSc thesis. Dr Kwesi Adu leads Priya’s current single-cell project and holds a university research appointment. Ms Ada Ibekwe is an operations manager and has not supervised scientific work.

sourceMaterials.title: Doctoral research goals
sourceMaterials.content: I seek a computational-biology PhD combining single-cell analysis, host–pathogen interactions and reproducible workflows. I need full funding. I have no formal disciplinary history.
